messages:
Anya: Quick sync on playground chat UX  a few user studies showed confusion around the single 'Stop' button. Link to updated mock: https://fig.ma/file/playground-streaming-v7. Need input on verbing, token counter placement, and resume behavior.
Diego: saw the mock. My vote: make semantic surface explicit: Continue vs Restart (instead of Pause/Stop). Continue implies state preserved; Restart implies clear + new generation.
Zoe: hmm I worry about unfamiliar verbs. Users might not know Continue will resume partial content. Maybe use 'Resume' vs 'Reset' so it's obvious.
Priya: accessibility angle: use verbs that are screen-reader-friendly. "Resume response" announced via aria-live when available. For discard actions, require an explicit confirm with clear copy: "Reset response  this will remove partial output".
Anya: microcopy experiments I'm trying:
```
Resume response (keeps progress)
Reset response (discard & start fresh)
Regenerate (create a new response from prompt)
```
Diego: token counter placement: two proposals: inline footer (muted) or toolbar popover. Inline is discoverable but noisy. Default should be hidden unless dev mode or hover/focus.
Zoe: agree hide by default. For inline footer make it keyboard-focusable and use aria-describedby for the estimate. Mobile: long-press to peek tokens.
Priya: keyboard shortcuts: propose Space toggles Resume/Stop when message focused; Shift+R for Regenerate with a modal confirm. Document shortcuts in Help and expose them via a small "keyboard" hint on hover.
design-bot: visual nit: use different icon fill states. Resume = outline play, Reset = filled square with danger color, Regenerate = circular arrow. Keep spacing to avoid accidental taps.
Anya: behavior question: if a message is paused/held and user clicks Regenerate, should we: A) resume and regenerate, or B) discard held state and start fresh? Current runtime does B. UX leaning B to avoid weird merges.
Diego: B is safer. Add an inline tooltip on Regenerate when there's held state: "Will discard held response".
Zoe: accessibility: announce when held state expires: "Held response expired" and remove resume affordance. Use a polite aria-live region for non-critical updates.
Priya: dev-mode token peek copy: "Tokens: 12  est $0.0012". Make sure currency formatting respects locale. Also add an ARIA label "token estimate".
Anya: action items: I'll update Figma with Resume/Reset labels and add a muted inline footer token peek (dev-mode only). Diego to draft tooltip copy for Regenerate & Reset. Zoe to write ARIA announcement strings. Priya to add shortcut docs.
design-bot: logged decisions in FigJam under "Streaming control verbs". Tagging @Anya for final copy. :white_check_mark:
accessibility-bot: checklist: aria-live for resume/reset, focusable token peek, visible focus ring, explicit confirm text for destructive actions, keyboard shortcut help page.
Anya: thanks all  I'll push updated mocks by EOD and loop back here for quick sign-off. :rocket:
